title: A mixed collection

doesNotKnow: The example combines specimens from two stipulated source ages in one later deposit. Their shared burial place alone does not show that the original animals lived together. Real sites require independent dating and context.

misconception: The first apparent interpretation is the only possible one.
objective: A modeled deposit contains one specimen from an older layer and another from a younger layer, both transported into it. Can the mixed deposit alone prove they lived at the same time?
